title: fix(app-shell): the preview error heading, the flow screen preview and the Debug run's CEL frames read the designer locale (objectui#10848)
body:
Fixes #10848
Clause-②: no — rows are added and a locale is passed; each en row equals today's literal. No declared surface or stored value moves.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 4 PM (claim `5860166845`, session `session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`), implemented on `claude/issue-10848-designer-preview-locale` as one commit, `e386a59`, on `main` `4aebea0`. It follows the objectui#10804 / objectui#10835 shape: `engine.*` rows whose en value is the literal it replaces, plus zh, read in the designer locale these surfaces already receive (or `useMetadataLocale()`).

## What changed

All under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`.

- **`previews/PreviewShell.tsx`, `PreviewErrorBoundary`.** The heading "Preview failed to render" reads `engine.previewShell.renderFailed`. A class component cannot call a hook, so the heading is a small function component, `PreviewErrorHeading`, which reads `useMetadataLocale()`. Every designer preview's boundary shows it in the designer language, including the previews that hold no locale of their own. See "The seam" below.
- **`previews/ScreenPreview.tsx`.** It takes an optional `locale` prop. Its own words read `engine.screenPreview.*` rows: the "Preview" header, the empty-state text, the disabled "Submit" button, the no-backend note passed to `ScreenView` as `noDataSourceMessage`, and the hidden-field note (`hiddenOne` / `hiddenOther`). The last two were found by the census of this file.
- **The locale threaded to it.** Both homes already hold the designer locale and now pass it: `inspectors/FlowNodeInspector.tsx` (the node inspector's screen preview) and `previews/FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx` (the Debug run's paused screen). Each is a one-token change.
- **`previews/simulator/flow-sim-validate.ts`.** `evalValueEnvelope`, `evalGuard`, `evalBranchPredicate` and the private `evalCelPredicate` take an optional trailing `locale`, the shape `validateFlowDraft` already has. It reaches only the frames this file writes around a CEL failure (`engine.flowSim.note.celEvaluationFailed` and `engine.flowSim.note.celConditionFailed`, each with a `{message}` hole), and the no-message fallback. The fallback reuses the existing `engine.flowSim.note.evaluationFailed` row, which has the same English, so no duplicate row is added.
- **`previews/simulator/flow-simulator.ts`.** The three call sites pass `this.locale`, the locale the constructor already takes. One doc comment line is updated.
- **`i18n.ts`.** 9 new en rows, each the literal it replaces, and 9 zh rows beside them. No existing row moves.
- **Pins.** `previews/previewStrings.i18n-10848.test.tsx`, 20 cases (see below).
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/10848-designer-preview-chrome-locale.md`, `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`.

**Producer text passes through unchanged.** The message inside a CEL frame is `@objectstack/formula`'s own text. objectstack-ai/objectstack#20291 gives it a code; this PR localizes only the frame. The spec refusals this file returns as they are (`structuralConditionRefusal`, `predicateSlotRefusal`, `EVALUATED_EXPRESSION_SOURCE_REQUIRED`, `ASSIGNMENT_VALUE_ENVELOPE_REFUSAL`, the Zod issues) and the message a failing preview threw are also left as written. A screen's title, description and field labels are author data and show as written.

## The seam: a hook for the boundary, the prop for the screen preview

- **`PreviewErrorBoundary`: `useMetadataLocale()`.**
  - The boundary has 25 production call sites in 22 preview files (a `git grep` reading at `e386a59`). 13 of those files never mention `locale`: they do not read the one their `MetadataPreviewProps` carry. Threading a prop would touch every one of those files, all outside the claim.
  - The hook is the source those props come from. Every production host of a preview reads `const locale = useMetadataLocale()` and passes it down: `ResourceEditPage`, `EmbeddedItemEditor` and `StudioDesignSurface`. So in the product, the hook and the prop give the same answer.
  - Inspectors already read the hook in this family (`FlowExprIssue`, `ConditionBuilder`, `FlowObjectListField`).
  - No new prop is added to the boundary, so there is no second source to fall back between.
- **`ScreenPreview`: a `locale` prop.** Both of its homes hold the locale as a prop. In the Debug run, the paused screen sits beside the step notes, which read the panel's `locale` prop (objectui#10835). A prop keeps the paused screen in the same language as the notes.

## H1: reproduced on the base, under zh-CN, through the real components

This is the red run of the new pins. The six component sources were at the base `4aebea0`: `PreviewShell.tsx`, `ScreenPreview.tsx`, `flow-sim-validate.ts`, `flow-simulator.ts`, `FlowSimulatorPanel.tsx` and `FlowNodeInspector.tsx`. For each, the blob equalled the base blob. The rows and pins were at HEAD. A trap restored the sources afterwards: the blob equalled HEAD for each path, and `git diff HEAD` was 0 bytes.

Result: `Tests 10 failed | 10 passed (20)`. The 10 failures are exactly the zh site cases, and all 10 en controls passed. The texts below are quoted from the failure diffs.

- The boundary heading, in the flow preview and in a bare boundary: "Preview failed to render".
- The Debug run's paused screen: header "Preview", button "Submit".
- The node inspector's empty screen: "Preview", then "Add a title, description, fields, or an object form to preview this screen."
- The hidden-field note: "1 field hidden by its “visible when” condition." and "2 fields hidden by their “visible when” conditions."
- The no-backend note: "Connect to a backend to preview this object form."
- A false-by-error guard: "discount > 1: condition failed to evaluate as CEL: Unknown variable: discount".
- The same predicate as a decision branch: "config.conditions[0].expression: condition failed to evaluate as CEL: …".
- An assignment's CEL value: "assignments.bad: CEL evaluation failed: Unknown variable: missing".
- A producer failure with no message: "boom == 1: Evaluation failed." and "assignments.bad: Evaluation failed."

Every en control passed on the base sources. Between them, those controls render all 9 new en rows and the reused `evaluationFailed` row. So each en row renders exactly what the base literal rendered.

Lit controls, green on the base on the same mounts: the flow preview's boundary hint (`engine.flowPreview.malformed`), the Debug run's Screen heading (交互页面) and its out-edge error result (错误), the screen-reached note, and the node inspector's kind label (节点).

## Pins and ablation

The pin file uses the objectui#10748 / objectui#10804 / objectui#10835 harness. It reads the rendered text of the real `FlowPreview`, `PreviewErrorBoundary`, `FlowSimulatorPanel`, `FlowNodeInspector` and `ScreenPreview`. Each zh value is read back from the catalogue and guarded by `zhRow`, and each en value is read through `t` / `tFormat` for `en-US`. The producer's message inside a CEL frame is read from `@objectstack/formula` itself and expected verbatim in both locales.

It uses two stand-ins:
- `FlowCanvas` throws on demand, which is how the flow preview's boundary is shown.
- `ExpressionEngine.evaluate` delegates to the real engine, except for the source `boom == 1`, where it throws an error with no message. That is the only way to reach the evaluators' fallback.

- **Head** `e386a59`: `Tests 20 passed (20)`.
- **Ablation**, one mutation, through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode on `e386a59`:
  - Change: `const locale = useMetadataLocale();` in `PreviewErrorHeading` became `const locale = undefined as string | undefined; void useMetadataLocale;`.
  - Anchor x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `eb776d0723` → `277e117452`.
  - Result: `Tests 2 failed | 18 passed (20)`. The 2 failures are exactly the zh boundary cases: the flow preview's boundary and the bare boundary whose caller passes no locale.
  - Restored: blob == HEAD (`eb776d0723`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - The pins import the source by relative path, so no `dist/` sits between the mutation and the run.

## Gates

Every line below was run on HEAD `e386a59`.

- **Related suites, 100 files.** They cover the whole `previews/` tree (the simulator tests included), every other test file that imports `PreviewShell`, `ScreenPreview`, `flow-sim-validate`, `flow-simulator`, `FlowSimulatorPanel`, `FlowNodeInspector` or `FlowPreview`, the metadata-admin i18n pin files, `packages/i18n`'s `perm-home-namespace-3546`, and the i18n gate scripts' own suites. Result: `Test Files 100 passed (100) · Tests 1594 passed (1594)`.
- **Declared narrowing.** The full `packages/app-shell` suite is left to CI.
- **Type check.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0. The dependency closure was built first (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, 28/28 tasks, all from the worktree cache). `--listFiles` shows that `tsconfig.test.json` compiles the new pin file.
- **eslint on the 8 changed source and test files.**
  - Every file is inside eslint's config (`--print-config` exits 0 for each).
  - `--format json`: 8 files, 0 errors, 3 warnings, all in `FlowNodeInspector.tsx` (`no-explicit-any` ×2, `set-state-in-effect`). The base file has the same 3 on the same lines.
  - No type-aware linting is configured (0 `parserOptions` / `projectService` in `eslint.config.js`), and no `eslint-rules/` rule reads the disk. So this diff cannot change any verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide lint is CI's.
- **The remaining gates.**
  - `check:i18n-designer-parity` 0: "Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders."
  - `check:i18n-drift` 0: "No designer-table en value changed in this range." (9 keys added, 0 en values changed.)
  - `check:i18n-keys` 0 and `check:designer-field-key-parity` 0.
  - `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new) and `check:control-bytes` 0.
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit` and `check:vi-mock-override-shape` 0.
  - `check:test-path-roots` 0 and `check:unreferenced-sources` 0.
  - `check:changeset-claims` 0 and `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0.
  - `check-changeset-presence` 0 and `check-changeset-no-major` 0.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: NOT GOVERNED (9 paths).
  - `check:i18n-dead-keys` is report-only. None of the 9 new rows is listed as a candidate.

## Census of the three files

**`PreviewShell.tsx`.**
- Localized: the boundary heading.
- Left as written:
  - The thrown error's message, which is the thrower's text.
  - `fallbackHint`, which is the caller's sentence (see Acceptance notes).
  - The `console.error` log line, which is for developers.
  - `hint` and `title`, which are not rendered, as their doc comments say.
  - `PreviewMessage` and `PreviewEmptyState` have no words of their own.

**`ScreenPreview.tsx`.**
- Localized: the header, the empty state, Submit, the no-backend note, and the hidden-field note (two rows, one and other).
- Left as written:
  - The screen's title and description (with `{var}` interpolation), which are author data.
  - The field labels drawn by `ScreenView`, which are author data.
  - `ScreenView`'s own object-form defaults ("Save & Continue", "Cancel" and its no-data-source fallback) belong to the runtime renderer this preview shares with `FlowRunner`. In the preview, `showSubmit` / `showCancel` are false and the no-backend note is passed in, so none of them renders here.

**`flow-sim-validate.ts`.**
- Localized: the two CEL frames and the fallback, at three catch sites.
- Left as written:
  - Producer text: the formula engine's messages, the spec refusals named above, and the Zod issue messages.
  - The `PATH: ` prefix on a Zod issue, which is a config path with no words of its own.
  - The `' '` separators.
  - `validateFlowDraft`'s messages already read `engine.flowValidate.*`.

## Serial

- The PM's read at `4aebea0` (21:53Z) found no open PR touching these files.
- objectui#10847 edits `DashboardPreview.tsx` in parallel. This PR does not touch it. The new rows sit after the `engine.flowSim.note.*` block in each table, away from the `engine.dashboardPreview.*` rows.

## Acceptance notes

These were found in passing, by reading source. They were not driven in a browser, and this is not a sweep.

- **Callers' English `fallbackHint` sentences.** 10 call sites in 7 preview files pass a literal English hint to `PreviewErrorBoundary`: `DatasetPreview`, `ObjectPreview`, `PageBlockCanvas`, `PagePreview` (2), `ReportPreview`, `SourcePageEditor` and `ViewPreview` (3). Under zh-CN they now sit under a zh heading. They are in the same family and outside this claim's files.
- **Other English words in preview files outside this claim.** For example, `ActionPreview`'s "AI: opted out" / "AI: exposed" pills and its "Visible when" / "Disabled when" condition labels. `celAuthoring.ts`'s CEL try-it result also carries "The predicate is empty." and an "Evaluation failed." fallback of its own.
- **The console preview gallery.** `apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx` passes `?locale=` to the previews' `locale` prop, but mounts `I18nProvider` with `defaultLanguage: 'en'`. So a surface that reads `useMetadataLocale()` follows the provider there, not `?locale=`. That now includes the boundary heading, and already included the inspectors named above. This is a dev harness; in the product, both sources are the same hook.
